text:
I had 140 bookmarks from the last 30 days.

Grok Bot graded the pile. That is not a library. That is a pile.

Steal this. I ran it in Grok Bot tonight:

Pull my last 30 days of bookmarks. For each one: one-line thesis, link, grade (high / medium / noise), and the mechanism I can steal. Do not list tools. If I cannot name the mechanism in one sentence, it is noise.

I kept a third. I turned the keepers into 10 skills with a trigger I can say out loud.

If enablement is busy but not moving the number, you have a library problem.

If you ran that grade in Grok Bot today, what would actually survive?
